case_number: 2025 INSC 333; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C)No.19182 of 2022)
summary: Landlord-tenant dispute; adverse possession claim; oral gift invalid without registration; permissive possession cannot mature into adverse possession; High Court reversal of concurrent findings set aside; eviction and rent recovery upheld; filing of title suit not barred after eviction decree.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment reversed; decrees of Trial and First Appellate Courts restored; respondent to vacate premises and pay arrears and damages.
